L28·N9842unmasked layer
Fires on mid-sequence continuation tokens inside formulaic strings — a digit in the middle of a phone/postal number, a capitalized function word inside a proper name ("Church **Of** All Nations"), or the unexpected word completing a set phrase ("should be **that** of", "toenails **any** more") — i.e., a surprising/low-probability filler token within an otherwise fixed expression; it is strongly suppressed on the more predictable analogues (":" in "50:50", "." ending a duration, "and" in "6 years old and on").

L30·N8891unmasked layer
